scope:
Compare geometry planes on identical reconstructed MF state pairs.

This evaluates the per-polygon affine PSDF geometry component used by current
CC-ECS. It does not run ECS, reconstruct an ECS solution, or predict its full
QP result. In particular ECS covariance margins and their SQP linearization
are not included in this geometry-only comparison.

implementation_evidence.per_obstacle_geometry_evaluation: control/cc_ecs_optimizer.py:_evaluate_cluster_geometry uses forward_clusters over all obstacle polygons.
implementation_evidence.affine_plane: _set_ecs_parameters forms one plane [gradient, distance-gradient@nominal_pose] per obstacle at every future stage.
implementation_evidence.full_row: The current ECS full row additionally subtracts d_min and a symbolic covariance support margin. Only plane-d_min is evaluated here.
implementation_evidence.default_covariance_difference: Current CCECSOptimizerParam sets all process-noise coefficients to zero, unlike CC-MF. No assumption of identical covariance models is made.

limitations: This is a geometry-component cross-evaluation on MF's reconstructed nominal/candidate pair, not an ECS counterfactual trajectory or proof about the full ECS QP. Per-obstacle planes also remain local approximations within each polygon.
